brief.headline: Binance hack: $6.3 billion in crypto stolen
brief.detail: North Korea-linked hackers stole about $6.3 billion from Binance, and investigators are racing to recover the funds before they can be laundered into cash.

brief.headline: Nasdaq 100 enters third technical correction this year
brief.detail: Investors dumped big tech stocks after a slew of disappointing earnings, putting the Nasdaq 100 on course for its third correction of 2026.

brief.headline: Intel shares plunge 29% on weak outlook
brief.detail: Intel fell 29% on a weak outlook as the tech selloff deepened, and the drop knocked $12 billion off the government's stake in the company.
